description: This PHP source file defines the class Kint_Decorators_Plain, which provides methods for decorating and rendering debugging output for variables and call stacks, including formatting for CLI and HTML modes. It includes color effects, symbols, trace decorations, and rendering utilities.

classes.name: Kint_Decorators_Plain
classes.description: A class providing static methods to decorate variables and traces for debugging purposes, supporting different output modes such as CLI and HTML.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Render a Kint variable data object with nested structures into a formatted string with optional level control.

methods.name: decorateTrace
methods.description: Create a formatted string representing a stack trace from trace data.

methods.name: _colorize
methods.description: Apply color or style to text depending on the mode, such as CLI or plain text.

methods.name: _char
methods.description: Return repeated characters or symbols, formatted according to the output mode.

methods.name: _title
methods.description: Generate a decorated title block for visual headers.

methods.name: wrapStart
methods.description: Return starting wrapper HTML or empty string based on mode.

methods.name: wrapEnd
methods.description: Return ending wrapper HTML including call site information if enabled.

methods.name: _drawHeader
methods.description: Construct the header string for a variable, including access, name, type, size, and value.

methods.name: _buildCalleeString
methods.description: Generate a link or description string for a call site based on file and line information.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialize debugging styles and determine color enablement based on environment settings.
